arguments_for_approve_pair: Development Plan Section 12's MSFT golden row explicitly states 'Bull A102 vs Bear A304', attributed to John's own supplied expectations.
A102 (enterprise AI/inference demand) and A304 (valuation risk) can plausibly be co-activated simultaneously for MSFT (Copilot/Azure AI narrative vs. rich multiple).
arguments_for_reject_pair: A102's canonical conflict_alphas is [] -- deliberately, consistently with A103/A201's identical 'supportive chain-input, zero declared conflicts' design pattern.
A304's canonical conflict_alphas explicitly lists A101/A301/A601 and not A102.
The Development Plan's own Section 4 (six mandatory pairs) excludes A102 vs A304 -- the Section 12 golden-row line contradicts the same document's own formal declaration.

MSFT's golden-row dominant-alpha list already contains A101, making 'Bull A101 vs Bear A304' (matching NVDA's row and Section 4) directly available without any pair addition -- the far more parsimonious reading of a same-document, adjacent-ID inconsistency.
The tension A102 might carry against A304 is already transitively expressed via the existing A301<->A304 pair (A102 supports A301 at weight 0.70; A301 conflicts A304 at weight 0.85).

Approving on general 'AI-growth-Alpha vs valuation-risk' logic would equally justify A103__A304 and A201__A304, which the taxonomy's design has consistently avoided across all MVP-10 authoring -- exactly the semantic over-generalization / duplicate-conflict risk this adjudication was asked to guard against.
The only evidence for approval is MSFT-specific (one golden-case line), not a general Alpha-to-Alpha semantic argument that would generalize to every other A102-exposed ticker.
No approved Product Decision or ADR (rank-2 authority) supports the pair; the canonical taxonomy contract (rank-3, outranks the Development Plan's rank-4) deliberately excludes it.
The one available MSFT saved run shows zero evidence for A102 (activation_score=0.0, evidence_count=0) -- no empirical push toward approval either.
decision_confidence: high -- converging evidence from ranks 1, 2, 3 authority sources, plus the Development Plan's own internal self-contradiction, with only a single ambiguous line as counter-evidence
